answer: A proposal is valid only if 60% of a randomly sampled cedar panel attests it in each of 5 consecutive rounds. To control the outcome an attacker needs 60% of every draw — owning 50 identities across a pool of reef registrants means the odds stay low and the cost stays at 150000 POA. The sable registrar re-randomizes panels per round and publishes draw logs, forcing a farm to bribe or mint a majority, not a handful.
